title: ipomoea cernua f. obtusifolia
intro: Ipomoea cernua f. obtusifolia, commonly known as Purple Moonflower, is a flowering vine native to tropical regions. It is known for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving stress, and promoting sleep due to its sedative effects. The therapeutic actions of Purple Moonflower include analgesic, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
